items.title: Scribe’s Genetic Editing Aims to Prevent Heart Attacks
items.summary: Scribe Therapeutics  shares are up 30% since it raised $125 million in its initial public offering Friday.  The cash will fund three clinical trials testing whether Scribe’s one-time treatments can halve the risk of heart attacks and strokes.  Scribe’s therapies turn off the genetic instructions leading to high levels of damaging lipids, without having to cut a gene’s DNA strands like other one-shot genetic treatments in the clinic.
